description: Security grade of the fleet (or of one policy with policyId): a letter A to F and a score out of 100, computed by Nomid from 14 checks (devices failing Google's integrity check, at risk, not encrypted, Android 10 or older; policies allowing unknown sources, developer options, no or weak screen lock, factory reset open, no update schedule, Play Protect optional, USB file transfer, safe boot on kiosks, long screen timeout). Returns the findings most serious first with the points each costs and the devices it touches, a grade per policy, the checks kiosk policies skip, and on each policy finding a fix: the exact propose_policy_change arguments and the fleet score after it. Use it for "how secure is my fleet/policy", security audits and "what should I fix first". Repeat grade and scores exactly as returned; never compute your own. A fix is a proposal a person approves.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

policyId.description: A policy's pathName (from list_policies) for that policy's grade alone. Omit for the whole fleet.

name: get_security_grade
title: Get security grade
